correctness.rationale: Exact cutwidth equals max(c,r-c). In the unique frozen-hub case the left-leaf set is an invariant and components are products of full adjacent-swap graphs. When h>=2, an allowed target inversion exists unless the target hub would have to cross the permitted rank interval boundary, contradiction. Therefore every Kendall unit can be decreased legally, proving all pairwise distances. Symmetric reversal yields the exact all-vertex eccentricity; direct edge counts finish the classification. Standalone code independently enumerates actual star cuts and BFS distances across 35 parameter cases, including up to 120,960 states, without using experiment as infinite proof.

value.rationale: Fixed-budget reachability is the motivating gap left open by the general 2k routing bound. The sharp optimum-width parity transition and exact geodesic recovery one budget unit above the even-star optimum distinguish a meaningful structural phenomenon, quantify all component and metric data and yield an optimal routing algorithm for every star size; it is not an arbitrary finite table or routine renaming of a known metric.
